_comment: Exact tracked file paths pre-vetted to use a function scripts/malware_scan.py otherwise treats as a hard-fail signal (process spawning, dynamic code execution), and why. Adding a new entry here is itself a security-relevant change: review the file's actual use of the flagged call before allowlisting it, the same way you would for any other change to security/.

exec_functions.reason: proc_open() spawns an isolated `php -r ...` subprocess with a constrained memory_limit to test the extension's behavior under memory exhaustion during signing — a deliberate PHPUnit test fixture, no user-controlled command construction.
